data "google_project" "current" {
  project_id = var.project_id
}

locals {
  workload_sa_email = var.workload_sa_email != "" ? var.workload_sa_email : try(module.foundation.workload_sa_email, "")
}

# Cloud Storage - Media Bucket for Catalog Assets
resource "google_storage_bucket" "media_bucket" {
  name                        = "${var.project_id}-media-bucket"
  location                    = var.region
  force_destroy               = true
  uniform_bucket_level_access = true

  labels = {
    environment = var.environment
    workload    = "castor-storefront"
  }
}

# Cloud Storage - Invoices Bucket with 30-day lifecycle auto-delete rule
resource "google_storage_bucket" "invoices_bucket" {
  name                        = "${var.project_id}-invoices-bucket"
  location                    = var.region
  force_destroy               = true
  uniform_bucket_level_access = true

  lifecycle_rule {
    condition {
      age = 30
    }
    action {
      type = "Delete"
    }
  }

  labels = {
    environment = var.environment
    workload    = "castor-factory"
  }
}

# Pub/Sub Topic for Asynchronous Orders
resource "google_pubsub_topic" "orders_topic" {
  name = "orders-topic"

  labels = {
    environment = var.environment
    workload    = "castor-orders"
  }
}

# Dedicated Pub/Sub Invoker Service Account for Cloud Run Push Subscription
resource "google_service_account" "pubsub_invoker" {
  account_id   = "pubsub-invoker-sa"
  display_name = "Pub/Sub Invoker Service Account"
  project      = var.project_id
}

# Grant Invoker Service Account permission to invoke Cloud Run services
resource "google_project_iam_member" "pubsub_invoker_run" {
  project = var.project_id
  role    = "roles/run.invoker"
  member  = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.pubsub_invoker.email}"
}

# Grant Pub/Sub Service Agent token creator role on the invoker SA for OIDC authentication
resource "google_service_account_iam_member" "pubsub_token_creator" {
  service_account_id = google_service_account.pubsub_invoker.name
  role               = "roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator"
  member             = "serviceAccount:service-${data.google_project.current.number}@gcp-sa-pubsub.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
}

# Pub/Sub Push Subscription targeting factory-worker Cloud Run URI
resource "google_pubsub_subscription" "factory_push_sub" {
  name  = "factory-orders-push-sub"
  topic = google_pubsub_topic.orders_topic.name

  push_config {
    push_endpoint = "${var.factory_worker_url}/api/v1/factory/process-order"

    oidc_token {
      service_account_email = google_service_account.pubsub_invoker.email
    }
  }

  ack_deadline_seconds = 60

  labels = {
    environment = var.environment
    workload    = "castor-factory"
  }
}

# Secret Manager Secret for Stripe Mock Key
resource "google_secret_manager_secret" "stripe_mock_key" {
  secret_id = "stripe-mock-key"

  replication {
    auto {}
  }

  labels = {
    environment = var.environment
    workload    = "castor-payment"
  }
}

resource "google_secret_manager_secret_version" "stripe_mock_key_version" {
  secret      = google_secret_manager_secret.stripe_mock_key.id
  secret_data = "mock_sk_test_castor_default_secret_key"
}

# Workload Service Account IAM Permissions
resource "google_secret_manager_secret_iam_member" "workload_stripe_access" {
  count     = local.workload_sa_email != "" ? 1 : 0
  secret_id = google_secret_manager_secret.stripe_mock_key.secret_id
  role      = "roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor"
  member    = "serviceAccount:${local.workload_sa_email}"
}

resource "google_storage_bucket_iam_member" "workload_invoices_admin" {
  count  = local.workload_sa_email != "" ? 1 : 0
  bucket = google_storage_bucket.invoices_bucket.name
  role   = "roles/storage.objectAdmin"
  member = "serviceAccount:${local.workload_sa_email}"
}

resource "google_storage_bucket_iam_member" "workload_media_viewer" {
  count  = local.workload_sa_email != "" ? 1 : 0
  bucket = google_storage_bucket.media_bucket.name
  role   = "roles/storage.objectViewer"
  member = "serviceAccount:${local.workload_sa_email}"
}

resource "google_pubsub_topic_iam_member" "workload_orders_publisher" {
  count  = local.workload_sa_email != "" ? 1 : 0
  topic  = google_pubsub_topic.orders_topic.name
  role   = "roles/pubsub.publisher"
  member = "serviceAccount:${local.workload_sa_email}"
}

# stackvend: from infra/workload/variables.tf (IAC_ENGINEER)


variable "environment" {
  type        = string
  description = "Deployment environment name"
  default     = "production"
}

variable "factory_worker_url" {
  type        = string
  description = "Cloud Run URI for the factory-worker microservice"
  default     = "https://factory-worker-placeholder.a.run.app"
}

variable "workload_sa_email" {
  type        = string
  description = "Service account email of the workload runtime (optional override if not using module.foundation.workload_sa_email)"
  default     = ""
}

# stackvend: from infra/workload/outputs.tf (IAC_ENGINEER)
output "gcs_bucket_name" {
  description = "Canonical GCS bucket name for media assets"
  value       = google_storage_bucket.media_bucket.name
}

output "media_bucket_name" {
  description = "Name of the media storage bucket"
  value       = google_storage_bucket.media_bucket.name
}

output "invoices_bucket_name" {
  description = "Name of the invoices storage bucket"
  value       = google_storage_bucket.invoices_bucket.name
}

output "pubsub_topic_id" {
  description = "Canonical Pub/Sub topic ID for orders"
  value       = google_pubsub_topic.orders_topic.name
}

output "orders_topic_name" {
  description = "Name of the orders Pub/Sub topic"
  value       = google_pubsub_topic.orders_topic.name
}

output "secret_stripe_mock_key" {
  description = "Canonical Secret Manager secret ID for Stripe mock key"
  value       = google_secret_manager_secret.stripe_mock_key.secret_id
}

output "factory_push_subscription_id" {
  description = "ID of the factory orders push subscription"
  value       = google_pubsub_subscription.factory_push_sub.id
}

output "pubsub_invoker_sa_email" {
  description = "Email of the dedicated Pub/Sub invoker service account"
  value       = google_service_account.pubsub_invoker.email
}

output "firestore_database_name" {
  description = "Referenced Firestore database name from foundation module"
  value       = try(module.foundation.database_name, "(default)")
}

module "compute_factory_worker" {
  source                = "../modules/compute-event-worker"
  project_id            = var.project_id
  region                = var.region
  product_id            = var.product_id
  service_account_email = module.foundation.workload_sa_email
  container_image       = replace(var.container_image, "/app:", "/factory-worker:")
  cpu_limit             = var.cpu_limit
  memory_limit          = var.memory_limit

  depends_on = [module.foundation]
}
